title: Ghost with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ghostGlow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#b8d8f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8ab8d8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='eyeGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d='M25,45 Q25,18 50,18 Q75,18 75,45 L75,72 Q75,78 70,78 Q65,78 63,72 Q61,66 57,66 Q53,66 51,72 Q49,78 45,78 Q41,78 39,72 Q37,66 33,66 Q29,66 27,72 Q25,78 20,78 Q15,78 15,72 Z' fill='url(#ghostGlow)'/>
  <!-- ghost body highlight -->
  <path d='M30,45 Q30,24 50,24 Q58,24 62,30 Q55,26 48,27 Q36,30 33,42 Z' fill='#f0f8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- ghost body shadow edge -->
  <path d='M75,45 L75,72 Q75,78 70,78 Q65,78 63,72 Q61,66 57,66 Q53,66 51,72 Q49,78 45,78 Q41,78 39,72 Q37,66 33,66 Q29,66 27,72 Q25,78 20,78 Q15,78 15,72 L15,45 Q16,50 17,52 Q18,58 20,58 Q22,58 22,52 L22,45 Z' fill='#7aaec8' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- left sparkly eye -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='7' ry='8' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='3' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- left eye sparkle rays -->
  <line x1='38' y1='31' x2='38' y2='34' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='42' x2='31' y2='42' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='34' x2='32' y2='36' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- right sparkly eye -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='42' rx='7' ry='8' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='3' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- right eye sparkle rays -->
  <line x1='62' y1='31' x2='62' y2='34' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='42' x2='69' y2='42' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='34' x2='68' y2='36' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- tiny cheek dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='2' fill='#ffb8c8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='2' fill='#ffb8c8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- cute little mouth -->
  <path d='M46,54 Q50,60 54,54' stroke='#6a9ab8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- floating sparkles around ghost -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='25' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='60' r='1' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='65' r='1' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='12' r='1.2' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
